body:
Candidate readiness; issue remains open.

Independent work-unit review accepted the exact candidate under plan 1: all 174 registered CPU CTests passed in each Linux Debug/Release × exceptions OFF/ON configuration (696 executions), independently rebuilt original-defect controls and an old-header caller passed their declared policies, and the 116-assertion contrast/scope oracle passed. Native Windows execution was explicitly skipped at the user request and remains unverified. These CPU results make no real GPU, Steam, driver-durability or general binary ABI claim. Parent issue #8 remains open; this candidate awaits separate final review and PR publication.

Candidate: `4f223c867b43ee3f01d643c0a77484c0cd4fd53a`; base: `a6b22d65badc61907060028514dc5e86c5ce6c3e`; plan: `1`; issue input: `0566990f53c68f16ae1da91700623466ba680c72b20b6a7e57f5b3ba294bf46d`.
